audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Trundle none of the seven stages (Skill, Skill, Skill, Mel, Skill, Skill, Mel) in a lane Mel wins 46.36% of over 151 games, and it read Mel at 2+ items directly above a why that says he out-scales hard.
audit.why: The mirror audit (audits/top/trundle__mel.json) reached the identical conclusion from the other side and named the exact cells: win[4] and win[6] should read Trundle. Its own page carries the same chart, so both sides move together. Level 6 is Subjugate — a 120/100/80 theft of Health, Armor and MR that doubles over four seconds — and two items in he is too durable for the Overwhelm execute to reach.
audit.corrected: win[4] and win[6] now read Trundle; phases[4].side and phases[6].side follow, with phases[4].rating 5/10 to 4/10 and phases[6].rating 7/10 to 3/10 so the numbers stay the inverse of Trundle's page.

audit.whatIsWrong: Seven separate strings credit Chomp with the sustain that decides this lane: early says 'his Frozen Domain bite (Q) heals it back' and 'his Q sustain', late says 'His Q bite drain', whys[0], whys[2], whys[3] and whys[6] all repeat 'his Q bite' healing. spikes[3] says 'Frozen Domain bite'.
audit.why: Riot's text for Chomp: 'Trundle bites his opponent, dealing damage, briefly slowing and sapping some of their Attack Damage.' There is no heal on it at all, and it is a flat 3.5s at 300 range. His sustain is King's Tribute — 'when an enemy unit dies near Trundle, he heals for a percent of its maximum Health' — amplified by Frozen Domain's 'increased healing from all sources while on it'. That changes the counterplay completely: you cannot deny Chomp, but you can deny King's Tribute by not letting him stand in the wave as it dies, and Grievous Wounds cuts both. A player told the heal is on a 3.5s bite will conclude the sustain is unstoppable.
audit.corrected: Chomp is now the AD sap on 3.5s; King's Tribute and Frozen Domain carry the sustain, with anti-heal timing named.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[1] told the player to spend Rebuttal on nothing because 'he has no projectile', and no string anywhere said what Subjugate actually takes.
audit.why: Rebuttal's value here is not the reflect — Riot's text also has it 'prevents her from taking damage, and grants her movement speed', on 38/35/33/29/26. Against a champion whose whole plan is Pillar of Ice terrain plus Frozen Domain move speed, the immunity and the speed are the ability. Subjugate 'immediately steals a percent of his target's Health, Armor and Magic Resistance', doubling over four seconds — so armour and magic resist bought against him are handed to him mid-fight, which the _missing file flags as resistances-invalidated. Whether Rebuttal reflects anything of his is unverified in both kit files, so no claim either way is made.
audit.corrected: Rebuttal is now damage immunity plus move speed on a 38s rank-1 timer; Subjugate's Health/Armor/MR theft is stated and resist-stacking is called out as the wrong buy.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns, tradeBad and dontsFull[2].d gave Rebuttal 'twenty seconds' and gave Subjugate and Pillar of Ice no numbers.
audit.why: Rebuttal is 38s at rank 1, not 20. Subjugate is 120/100/80 — the same timer as Golden Eclipse, which makes level 6 a straight race. Pillar of Ice is 21/19.5/18/16.5/15 at 1000 range and creates impassable terrain against a champion with no dash; that wall, not the bite, is what kills Mel.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, tradeBad, dontsFull[2].d and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal timing anywhere in the content layer, and the page implicitly recommends surviving him rather than buying against him.
audit.why: King's Tribute plus Frozen Domain's healing amplification is the reason poke does not stick, and it is exactly what Grievous Wounds answers. The mirror confirms Trundle's plan is the extended trade.
audit.corrected: late now names Morellonomicon and says resist stacking feeds Subjugate.

edits.before: Trundle has no gap-closer and no ranged threat for your W to eat, so your Q poke and the Solar Snare root are free as long as you respect his pillar. At level 2 with Q and E you can root him the instant he walks up to a minion and chunk him before his Frozen Domain bite (Q) heals it back. The catch: his Q sustain means your early chip evaporates fast, so don't trade just to trade, hit him when he steps into CS range and punish, otherwise hold your stacks.
edits.after: Trundle has no dash and answers at Chomp's 300 range, so Radiant Volley at 950 and Solar Snare at 1000 are free as long as you respect Pillar of Ice (21s at rank 1). At level 2 you can root him the instant he walks up to a minion and chunk him before King's Tribute heals it back off the dying wave. Chomp is not his sustain — it saps your Attack Damage on a flat 3.5s — but his passive heals off every unit that dies near him, so punish the step-up and otherwise hold your stacks.

edits.before: This is your window to apply real pressure: keep max range, stack Overwhelm with Q and empowered autos, and at 6 detonate Golden Eclipse for burst he can't pre-heal. But never get walled, his Pillar of Ice (E) can pin you against terrain and his Frozen Domain (W) speed lets him close the gap, and the second he lands on you with Subjugate (R) up he steals your resistances and out-heals the whole trade. Root him with Solar Snare to peel the walk-up, then disengage before his R flips it.
edits.after: This is your window: keep max range, stack Overwhelm with Q and empowered autos, and at 6 detonate Golden Eclipse — it shares Subjugate's 120/100/80 timer, so whoever ults first owns the fight. Never get walled: Pillar of Ice (21s, 1000 range) is impassable terrain and you have no dash, while Frozen Domain's move speed closes the gap. Subjugate steals your Health, Armor and Magic Resistance, so armour is the wrong buy — root the walk-up with Solar Snare and disengage before his R lands.

edits.before: He reclaims this lane outright once itemized. His Q bite drain and natural tankiness out-sustain your poke faster than you can stack, and a beefed-up Trundle is too healthy for Overwhelm to ever execute. With Subjugate he becomes a wall that heals through your entire combo, so stop trying to 1v1 the pillar all-in, group with your team, kite him in the open where his only engage is walking, and never let him corner you on a wall.
edits.after: He reclaims this lane outright once itemized. King's Tribute heals a percent of every unit that dies near him and Frozen Domain amplifies all of it, so buy Morellonomicon early or your poke never sticks. Subjugate steals Health, Armor and Magic Resistance — resist stacking hands him the stats — so buy damage and range instead. Stop trying to 1v1 the pillar all-in: group, kite him in the open where his only engage is walking, and never let him corner you on a wall.

notes: Mirror alignment: audits/top/trundle__mel.json flagged the level chart but explicitly declined to edit it, believing enum fields would be rejected. That belief is wrong (apply-proposals.js:78 exempts them), so I made the flips it named — win[4] and win[6] to Trundle — on this side. Its 'corrected' sentence also mentions Level 3 going to Trundle and Levels 1-2 going to Mel, but it listed only win[4] and win[6] as the cells to change, so I moved only those two; see questionsForUser. Packet tools/audit-run/packets/mel.json reports games:null for trundle while MC_REAL_GAMES.mel.trundle is 151 — packet build defect, not missing data. Left alone as unverified: whether Rebuttal reflects anything in Trundle's kit. Chomp is a targeted bite and Pillar of Ice is a ground-targeted terrain cast, neither reads as a projectile, but the kit files' needsResearch blocks are empty, so I removed the page's negative assertion rather than replacing it with the opposite claim.
